source_contract.enable_sink_function: EN_N OR NOT(GATE); input HIGH means LED sink high-impedance
source_contract.qualified_filter: LTC6994-2; RSET60400R1%; NDIV1/POL0; no threshold interpolation
source_contract.raw_permission_input_slew_requirement: AHCT Schmitt accepts slow input; measured wiring noise envelope remains qualification
source_contract.brownout_rule: Actual rail monitors withdraw MOTOR_POWER_OK before any logic/driver/qualifier rail leaves its valid window. Between zero and valid supply no logic truth or contact timing is guaranteed.
source_contract.startup_rule: TX_PERMIT kept LOW until all rails valid, qualifier startup observed and deliberate arm/self-test completed; LTC start-up time is typical, not a guaranteed fixed timeout.

open_gates: Parent must provide and independently supervise MOTOR_IO_3V3, both MOTOR_5V rails and bank AUX_5V/AUX_24V supplies; no power supply is fabricated by flags.
MOTOR_POWER_OK_*_QUALIFIED must include actual rail/field health, early brownout withdrawal, startup held disabled and deliberate rearm; never tie HIGH.
Digital qualifier bounds are conditional on specified voltages, temperature, RSET tolerance/TCR, source/trace load and startup completion; no physical pulse/noise test has occurred.
Source LED current screen uses 25C diode Vf limits at10mA and maximum logic VOL; cold/hot/ageing trigger/current/return and full-temperature relay timing remain physical qualification.

Direct per-channel gate removes TPS/QOD timing from powered-logic withdrawal, but powered-low ramps/missing receiving rails require actual parent monitor/power sequencing. TPS22918 turn-off and QOD are typical-only and never counted as a guaranteed watchdog bound.
Both photorelay lands follow manufacturer reference patterns; final assembly/stencil and isolation review remain open.
ISO1212 uses TI DBQ0016A example lands;12 separate SUB nets require actual floating2x2mm PCB islands, no ground or inter-island bridge, with isolation/stencil review.
All12 motor connector exact MPN/mate/orientation, isolation clearance, high-current rails, shielding and transient return layout remain parent engineering.
TVS rated-pulse clamp below60V at25C is only component screening; temperature, surge source/energy, overshoot, dV/dt and containment remain unqualified.
Unpowered/brownout ISO1212 output is invalid; FPGA/software must mask until independent receiving-rail qualification and freshness.
No receiver fail-safe claim for tri-stated STEP/DIR; drive profiles and independent STO/drive-power stop path remain required.
Native ERC/netlist checks do not establish pin allocation, routing, DRC, FPGA fit, target operation or manufacture readiness.
